'''Ko-oda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]], who lived during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was a member of the [[Crystal Wasters]], a surfer gang that was based on [[Dorumaa]].
